title: ½ Price Whittaker's Slab Milk Chocolate Bar 50g $1.50 (Was $3) @ Coles
body:
Deal: ½ Price Whittaker's Slab Milk Chocolate Bar 50g $1.50 (Was $3) @ Coles

[t25] One of the best chocolate bars out there.
[t25] Unlike Cadbury they don't use palm oil to bulk up their chocolates.
[abjsdhasehasee] Full Cream Milk, Sugar, Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Mass, Milk Solids, Emulsifiers, Flavour.
Can you point out the palm oil in the ingredients list above?
[Hugh G Rection] you love deez nutz? how is the almond slab?
[t25] I bought so many when they were $1 each.
Not so much these days.
[BullishBuyer] i miss when these were 80c when i was a kid. don't ask me when that was
[Think] 50c bonus is found Home -> Receipts -> Grocery category or Woolies/Coles logos 50c bonus under Shop by store-> Whittaker's
[Lets Go Brandon] This chocolate was born a healthy 300g and was happy until modern expectations of beauty, social media and Albo came along.
[Headless] Just shows the new default price has jumped to $3…
Used to be bought at $1 not too long ago
[ASR-Briggs] So with the shopback receipt claim, is that 50c per item? or 50c per receipt (meaning you need to do separate transactions for each)? Is there a cap? I never done it before
[musicinbed69] The height of these really make each bite more satisfying than the blocks.
